text:
69세 여성 환자, 급성 severe GI bleeding secondary to peptic ulcer disease로 입원.

BP 85/55 mmHg, HR 120 bpm, RR 22 bpm, BT 36.8°C, SpO2 92% (room air).

Severe hematemesis 호소함.

Pantoprazole 80 mg IV q12h 적용함.

Nasal cannula at 2 L/min 유지함.

Endoscopic hemostasis 시행함.

C-line 유지함.

Negative fluid balance 확인됨.

환자 drowsy 상태.

Gastroenterology team notify함 for urgent endoscopy.
